paper_metadata.title: Statistics-informed parameterized quantum circuit: towards practical quantum state preparation and learning via maximum entropy principle

summary: This paper proposes SI-PQC, a gate-based quantum state-preparation framework for statistical distributions and mixtures, and validates it on a noiseless QPanda/pyqpanda statevector simulator. It reports asymptotic resource scalings such as single-shot MEDL depth O(n M df log(1/ε)), mixture-loading depth O((nx M df + nθ + dθ) log(1/(εF))), and SI-PQC state-preparation for derivative pricing with Poly3(n) ∈ O(n log n) versus a benchmark Poly2(n) ∈ O(n^2), plus a 5-qubit empirical-risk example for online VaR estimation.
